news.title: Benson education plan: Up teacher pay, tackle absenteeism, change constitution
news.summary_en: Benson’s plans include continuing signature efforts of the Whitmer administration and several ideas that would need support from the Legislature.
news.author: Isabel Lohman

news.title: As MSU president exits, what the heck is going on? We have (some) answers
news.summary_en: Kevin Guskiewicz said board members had ‘differing perspectives’ on how MSU should move ahead. Gov. Gretchen Whitmer called his departure disappointing but not surprising.
news.author: Kim Kozlowski

news.title: MSU loses another president, in spite of $1 million pay raise
news.summary_en: MSU President Guskiewicz is set to become the next president of Clemson University in South Carolina even after board voted to increase his annual salary to $2 million.
news.author: Kim Kozlowski

news.title: What to know about school tax credit program. Will Michigan opt in or stay out?
news.summary_en: Michigan private and public school students could benefit from a federal tax credit scholarship program. Here’s what to know.
news.author: Isabel Lohman

news.title: Michigan Teacher of the Year helps special ed students overcome hurdles
news.summary_en: Erik Meerschaert, the 2026-27 Michigan Teacher of the Year, helps special education students find success inside and outside the classroom. As teacher of the year, he hopes to spotlight other teachers’ successes.
news.author: Nate Miller
